name: Tide Display
author: ChuckBuilds
description: Coastal tide display with animated wave level, tide schedule, 24-hour chart, and tidal statistics. Powered by the free NOAA Tides & Currents API (US stations, no API key required).

versions.notes: Snap the customization font_size defaults onto their faces' pixel grids -- 4x6-font is crisp only at multiples of 7, PressStart2P only at multiples of 8. Off the grid FreeType anti-aliases to fake the in-between stroke widths, and under the 1-bit rendering these plugins draw with, the mono rasteriser drops a column from every glyph (a 4x6 glyph at ppem 6 comes out 3px wide, so W/M and 0/8 stop being distinguishable). Unlike the grid-aware scoreboards, this plugin has no crisp_size() snapping, so the schema default is what actually renders.

Reliability: serve recent cached tides (up to 2 days) when a NOAA fetch fails instead of a stuck 'Loading' screen, and log NOAA error responses that were previously swallowed silently. Cache keys are no longer date-stamped, so entries overwrite in place instead of leaking one per day; old per-day keys are pruned automatically.

Config schema reorganized for a clearer setup experience: fine-tuning fields moved behind the web UI's collapsed Advanced Settings section (x-advanced). UX-only; no fields, defaults, or behavior changed.
Add a GPL-3.0 LICENSE file (project-standard license).
Add per-screen toggles (Show Current/Schedule/Chart/Stats) so users can turn individual display modes on or off from the config UI. Disabling every screen falls back to showing all of them.

Readability overhaul: reduce water fill cap to 18% (thin strip, maximum sky for text), wave amplitude reduced ~35%, 1px drop shadow on current-mode text labels, chart axis labels properly centered and clamped to display edges, stats cycle-% label moved above bar to prevent bottom clip.

Fix text invisible on hardware: assign display_manager.image before rendering so draw_text() targets the correct canvas. Replace bare PIL draw.text() calls with display-font helpers. Brighten dim colours (C_DIM, C_GRID, C_LABEL, C_BAR_OUT). Use configured tide_color/highlight_color in water and chart rendering. Increase schedule bar height.
